profile.summary: Inspection Services, Inc. (ISI) is a woman-owned small business founded in 1995. It provides quality assurance, quality control, special inspection and construction materials testing for new construction and retrofit projects. Its clients include public agencies, schools, hospitals and private builders, mostly in California.
